== Notes ==
* The projectile's arc is much higher than similar spells like [[Fireball]].
* This spell will not [[fail]] if the target dies during its casting.
* The healing does not affect allied [[spirit]]s.
* Useful when playing alongside a [[Minion Master]] or close combat professions, as they will benefit from the healing reliably if they're targeting the same enemy.
